signature_info.description: Microsoft Quality Windows Audio Video Experience (qWave) Support Driver

crowdsourced_ai_results.analysis: The analyzed binary is a legitimate Windows kernel-mode driver belonging to the Quality Windows Audio/Video Experience (qWAVE) component, typically named 'qwavedrv.sys'. The driver manages network traffic flows for multimedia applications. Key indicators of its benign nature include the use of Windows Implementation Libraries (WIL) for feature staging (e.g., 'wil_InitializeFeatureStaging'), standard implementation of IRP dispatch routines (Create, Close, Cleanup, DeviceControl), and robust security practices such as building and applying Access Control Lists (ACLs) to its device object ('DrvBuildAdminAcl', 'DrvBuildDeviceAcl'). The IOCTL handlers (AddFlow, RemoveFlow, SetFlow, QueryFlow) align with the documented functionality of the qWAVE service. No malicious behavior, such as unauthorized hooking or data exfiltration, was detected. Relevant IOCs include the device name '\Device\QWAVEdrv' and references to the AFD driver ('\Driver\AFD').
